viv: Kicking off 'Needlethread' launch content sprint. We need: final keyword set, structured data for webinar, internal link map for the launch cluster, and a redirect table for legacy campaign URLs. Who volunteers for canonical audit + redirect QA?
lena: I can do the canonical audit. Will output a list: page,path,current_canonical,recommendation. Also will add meta robots checks for staging.
omar: I'll handle redirects + lead routing. CSV format: old_url,new_url,http_status,reason,qa_steps. Will ensure querystrings preserved and UTMs appended.
seo-bot: scan: Suggested schema: Event, FAQPage, BreadcrumbList. Recommend attendanceMode:"https://schema.org/OnlineEventAttendanceMode" and include organizer with sameAs pointing to company profile.
lena: Keywords to prioritize: "LLM inference", "production LLM serving", "low latency LLM". Long-tail: "optimize LLM serving cost", "LLM inference on mixed GPU fleets". I'll tag intent and map to landing vs blog.
ovar: Internal links: cluster hub = benchmark narrative, spokes = product pages, docs, webinar. 2-3 contextual links per blog. Use consistent anchor text: 'LLM inference platform', 'deploy LLMs', and 'join the webinar'.
viv: Great. Deliverables and rough dates: canonical audit (lena) Thu, redirects + CSV (omar) Fri, JSON-LD snippets (seo-bot/jules) Thu, CTA variants + email subject lines (viv) Wed. Drop one-line status here when done. :rocket:
